guidebook.intro: Yogera ku by’ogenda okukola enkya, ku wiikendi n’olunaku lumu.

tips.title: “I will”
body: **Nja ku-** kiba **I will**: **I will go. We will study together.** Ekikolwa ekidako tekikyuka: **Nakato will come**, si “will comes”.
Era abantu bagamba **I am going to**: **I am going to visit Jjajja.**

tips.title: Olunaku lumu
body: Mu Lusoga waliwo engeri ey’enjawulo ku biseera ebiri ewala: **ndigenda**. Mu Lungereza kye kimu **will**, wabula oyongerako ekiseera: **One day I will go to Buganda. Next year I will study science.**
**I hope to** kitegeeza nsuubira: **I hope to see the Kabaka.**

culture.title: “Katonda bw’anaayagala”
body: Abantu bangi bagatako **Katonda bw’anaayagala** ku nteekateeka zaabwe. Mu Lungereza kiba **God willing** oba **hopefuly**: **I will see you tomorrow, God willing.**
